answer: Each round, a randomness beacon picks 5% of registered agents for a surprise liveness audit, and every audited agent must reveal a signed work trace within 20 blocks. Operators running many fakes at the wharf of one funding address face a 25 POA challenge deposit per audited identity, forfeited on failure, so ten clones carry roughly 250 POA of exposure per round. Any knoll of near-identical traces is clustered by validators, who slash the deposit and publish the proof on-chain.
